question: outcome_summary
answer: The study found that bipolar I disorder (BD) among Indian patients has a mean age of onset around 26 years and an average duration of illness of 199 months. Patients experienced an average of 9 episodes over 17 years, with a significant portion of time spent in depressive episodes. High rates of comorbidity were noted, with 43% of patients having current psychiatric conditions, and 77% experienced functional impairment in the two years prior to the study. Additionally, medication nonadherence was prevalent, with 58% of patients being nonadherent to treatment regimens.
